Items before: English muffin with ham (maybe egg sandwich component), toast 2 slices, fried/poached egg(s), avocado, banana, muffin, yogurt, peaches in bowl, orange juice, peanut butter, jam/honey packets.

Estimated calories:
- English muffin with ham: ~170 kcal, 90 g
- Toast, 2 slices: ~160 kcal, 60 g
- Eggs (2 poached/fried): ~160 kcal, 100 g
- Avocado, ~1/2: ~120 kcal, 75 g
- Banana: ~100 kcal, 118 g (peel excluded)
- Muffin: ~350 kcal, 100 g (the liner is empty)
- Yogurt: the cup still holds some, so about 2/3 eaten, 150 g tub: ~120 kcal total, ~80 kcal eaten, ~100 g
- Peaches: ~40 kcal, 80 g
- Orange juice: ~110 kcal, 200 g
- Peanut butter and jam packets: the packets are open and used, ~100 kcal, 25 g

Sum of kcal: 170+160+160+120+100+350+80+40+110+100 = 1390.
Sum of mass: 90+60+100+75+118+100+100+80+200+25 = 948.

The second photo shows no sign of the muffin top, the egg, or the toast, so I assume everything was eaten. The tray also shows a bit of jam residue and some avocado residue. I'll shave slightly for the leftovers.
